rationales.seed_block: A new contiguous 64-world block reruns V2.2 recovery without reusing earlier development draws.
rationales.repair_seed_block: A disjoint 256-world block estimates the repaired zero-association floor profile.
rationales.root_prior: Inherited unchanged from V2.2 so the strain change is confined to association structure.
rationales.meaning_likelihood_reliability: Inherited unchanged from V2.2 to preserve local corrective uptake.
rationales.association_low: Inherited unchanged for the original 2x2 regression.
rationales.association_high: Inherited unchanged and equals the slab prior-predictive center.
rationales.history_length: Inherited unchanged for original V2.2 recovery regressions.
rationales.repair_history_length: Matches the localized finite-history regime used to diagnose the soft-zero leak.
rationales.association_existence_prior: A modest 0.6 sparsity prior makes exact absence available without overwhelming finite evidence for a real association.
rationales.association_slab_prior: Beta(match=9,mismatch=1) places associated mass near .9 and makes the slab honest about representing an association rather than duplicating the null.
rationales.zero_association_reliability: Theta=.5 is exact binary factorization and therefore the structural spike.
rationales.phi_admission: Inherited unchanged so precision gating and mediation are not repaired indirectly.
rationales.floor_band: Retains the sealed challenge's localized untreated-transfer floor for the open repair assay.
